scope: Focused water development checks; not final browser or visual acceptance
environment: Windows PowerShell, Node 24.15.0; concurrent baseline browser capture during initial run

initial.source: Working tree after first water candidate, before patch-center correction; no frozen source hash was taken. Existing six-test version ran before the added contour/cache assertions.
initial.failures: first-crossing, holding-pier and bellwater decorative seabed checks: tests/unit/water.test.ts:22 expected apronSamples.some(sample.height < -0.04 && sample.height > -0.9) to be true; received false.
initial.cause: Coast-attached forms were centered so close to shore that their raised height reached the -0.04 cap.
initial.correction: Move low sand tongue center from front.y + 0.18 to +0.4; other front form center from +0.12 to +0.35; side stone center from side.x -0.1 to +0.18. Existing assertion retained.

affectedRerun.source: Corrected candidate with added exact contour edge/corner check and field texture identity/content through tide and Undo checks.

typecheck.source: Initial water candidate before test additions

visualRefinement.basis: Native actual frozen candidate Holding ordinary/flooded tide2 and Bellwater tide2 inspected. Candidate narrows broad halos but foreground sand tongues stretched and overly pale.
visualRefinement.change: Bound one-step decorative parallax to .55 world depth; narrow tongue minor axes and reduce offshore sand contribution; preserve flooded interior stone and sand values. Also precompute mask path squared distances and width once per texel.
visualRefinement.command: npm run test:unit -- tests/unit/water.test.ts; npm run typecheck

finalWaterCandidate.basis: Native frozen Bellwater844 ordinary still had thick coastal rim; narrowed the actual shelf drop before final freeze. Neutral lamp uniform now receives explicit lighthouse anchor from World.
finalWaterCandidate.command: npm run test:unit -- tests/unit/water.test.ts; npm run typecheck
